description: This file defines the CRC class interface for CRC computations, including methods for extending, unextending, scrambling, and concatenating CRCs, specifically for the CRC32C polynomial. It also includes licensing and include guards.

classes.name: CRC
classes.description: Abstract class defining CRC computation interface, including methods for CRC manipulation and a singleton accessor for CRC32C.

methods.name: Empty
methods.description: Sets the CRC of an empty string.

methods.name: Extend
methods.description: Extends the CRC with additional bytes.

methods.name: ExtendByZeroes
methods.description: Extends the CRC with zero bytes.

methods.name: UnextendByZeroes
methods.description: Removes zero bytes from the end of a CRC.

methods.name: Scramble
methods.description: Applies a non-linear transformation to CRC.

methods.name: Crc32c
methods.description: Returns singleton instance of CRC32C implementation.
